_comment: Tier-2 for skfem dg_methods#3, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. The quadratic form z^T F z of the interior-facet flux matrix is positive for every probe with np.minimum(sv*bn,0) (upwind, dissipative), indefinite and ~30x smaller with 0.5*sv*bn (centered, no net dissipation), and negative for every probe with np.maximum(sv*bn,0) (downwind, anti-dissipative). The downwind operator makes the pure-advection matrix exactly singular (spsolve -> NaN) and with a 1e-2 mass shift the solution reaches O(1e12) instead of [0,1]; the centered flux overshoots the advected front more than upwind. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 applies the documented one-token fix inside flux_coefficient -- the 'centered' (0.5*sv*bn) and 'downwind' (np.maximum(sv*bn, 0.0)) branches both return the correct upwind np.minimum(sv*bn, 0.0). Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 / NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 10 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 8 of them, including 'centered_quadform_indefinite=True', 'downwind_quadform_all_negative=True', 'downwind_all_nan=True', 'Matrix is exactly singular', 'downwind_with_mass_shift_max_abs_gt_1e6=True' and 'centered_overshoot_exceeds_upwind=True', so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
